newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA appoints Edey head of economic analysis.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA appoints Edey head of economic analysis.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) said on Friday it had appointed Malcolm Edey as head of its economic analysis department.
The RBA said Edey, who joined the Reserve Bank in 1977, has held a number of positions in the bank's economic group and was mostly recently head of the economic research department.
The central bank said Edey's appointment created a vacancy as head of economic research department and that it would advertise internally and externally for the position.
